questions: Dating back roughly 250 million years to the early Triassic, these ground-dwelling herbivorous insects use powerful hind legs to leap away from danger and hatch as nymphs that molt five times — what's the insect?
Grasshopper are a group of insects belonging to the suborder Caelifera.

Natasha Rothwell: American actress and writer (born 1980)
Which of these four has been around longest?
Volvo Cars (founded 1927) is the earliest of the four. The company manufactures SUVs, station wagons, and sedans.

After a £750,000 move from Leeds United to Liverpool in 2005, this English goalkeeper made nine appearances for the Reds, including a Champions League quarter-final win over Juventus — who is he?
Better known by his nickname 'Calico Jack,' this English pirate was hanged in 1720 and is remembered for his two female crew members, Anne Bonny and Mary Read — who was he?
John Rackham: English pirate (died 1720). John Rackham (hanged 18 November 1720) was an English pirate operating in the Bahamas and Jamaica during the early 18th century.
